periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Primary axis is oriented vertically with a slight medial tilt at the superior pole.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Vertical oval morphology with a height-to-width ratio of approximately 2:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering with the inferior margin extending significantly below the geometric centroid.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Ears are positioned at the lateral cranial margins with a gap approximately 1.5 times the horizontal width of a single pinna region.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, convex semicircular curvature at the apex.

other_distinctive_markers: The apex of the pink tongue is visible, protruding slightly from the oral cavity; ventral fur exhibits significant brown discoloration compared to the cranial pelage.
